apps.name: Drift
apps.title: Drift: Sleep Sounds and White Noise App for iPhone
apps.description: Drift is a free sleep sounds app for iPhone with white noise, rain, ocean and fan sounds, a fade out sleep timer and offline playback.
apps.answer: Drift is a free iPhone and iPad app that plays seamless sleep sounds (white noise, rain, ocean, stream and fan free; thunder, forest, night, fire, wind and cafe with Premium) with a sleep timer that fades out, playback with the screen locked, and no internet needed.
apps.pricing: Free with five sounds and ads. Premium unlocks all eleven sounds and removes ads, monthly or annual, with a free week for new subscribers.
bestFor: falling asleep faster with white noise or rain
masking snoring, traffic or noisy neighbors
sleeping on planes or anywhere without signal
features: Eleven seamless sleep sounds with no gap at the loop
Sleep timer that fades out after 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour or 2 hours
Keeps playing with the screen locked
Works offline, every sound ships in the app
Dim sleep mode that will not light up the room
No account needed
faq: Is Drift free?
Yes. White noise, rain, ocean, stream and fan are free. Premium unlocks six more sounds and removes ads, and new subscribers get a free week.
Does Drift work without internet?
Yes. Every sound is stored inside the app, so it plays on a plane, in a cabin or with your phone in airplane mode.
Will Drift keep playing when my screen locks?
Yes. Drift uses background audio, so sound keeps going with the phone locked, all night or until the sleep timer fades it out.
Which sound is best for sleep?

Steady sounds like white noise and fan are best for masking sharp noises such as snoring or traffic. Rain, ocean and stream suit people who find pure noise harsh. Drift lets you preview every sound, so try a few for a night each.
Can I set a sleep timer?
Yes. Pick 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour or 2 hours and the sound fades out gently instead of stopping abruptly.

apps.name: SignSnap
apps.title: SignSnap: Sign PDF Documents on iPhone, No Account
apps.description: SignSnap lets you scan or import a PDF, add your signature and send it from your iPhone. No account and no uploads. First 2 documents free.
apps.answer: SignSnap is an iPhone and iPad app for signing documents: scan paper with the camera or import a PDF, draw, type or photograph your signature, place it on the line and share a clean PDF. It needs no account and keeps documents on the device.
apps.pricing: Free for the first 2 signed documents. Premium is weekly, monthly or yearly, with a free week for new subscribers.
bestFor: signing a PDF on iPhone
signing a lease, offer letter or permission slip from a phone
people who do not want to make an account or upload documents to a cloud service
replacing print, sign and scan
features: Draw, type or photograph your signature
Camera scanner with automatic edge detection
Import PDFs from Files, Mail or any app
Drag, resize and rotate the signature onto the line
Share a PDF to Mail, Messages or AirDrop
No account and no cloud uploads
faq: How do I sign a PDF on my iPhone with SignSnap?
Open the PDF in SignSnap from Files or Mail (or scan the paper with the camera), add your saved signature, drag it onto the line and tap share to send the signed PDF.
Do I need an account?
No. SignSnap works without an account, and documents stay on your iPhone instead of being uploaded.
Is SignSnap free?
Your first 2 signed documents are free. After that, Premium is weekly, monthly or yearly, and new subscribers get a free week.
Can I sign with Apple Pencil?
Yes. Draw with a finger or Apple Pencil, type your name in a script font, or photograph your ink signature.

apps.name: CelebriDay
apps.title: CelebriDay: What Holiday Is It Today? App for iPhone
apps.description: CelebriDay tells you what national day it is today, with a morning notification, a fun fact and a share card for 365 plus holidays.
apps.answer: CelebriDay is an iPhone and iPad app that tells you what fun or national holiday it is today, from National Pizza Day to World Emoji Day, with a morning notification, a fun fact and a shareable card for each day of the year. The same list is free on the web at graysmithlabs.com/holidays/.
apps.pricing: Free with ads. Premium, monthly or annual with a free week for new subscribers, lets you choose exactly when the daily alert arrives.
bestFor: finding out what national day it is today
teachers, social media managers and offices looking for daily themes
daily conversation starters and fun facts
planning posts around upcoming national days
features: Morning notification with today's holiday
A fun fact for every holiday
Color coded share cards
A calendar of the whole year
Favorites
Free daily holiday pages on graysmithlabs.com/holidays/
faq: What holiday is it today?
The today page at graysmithlabs.com/holidays/ lists every verified observance for today, and the CelebriDay app sends it to your phone each morning with a fun fact.
Are the holidays in CelebriDay real?
Every observance on the website is checked against a public source before it is published, and moving holidays are recalculated each year.
Is CelebriDay free?
Yes, CelebriDay is free with ads. Premium, monthly or annual with a free week to try it, lets you pick exactly when the morning alert arrives.
Can I share a holiday?
Yes. Every holiday has a card you can share to Messages, Instagram or anywhere else.

apps.name: SayBright
apps.title: SayBright: Daily Affirmations App with Widgets
apps.description: SayBright is a daily affirmations app for iPhone with 340 plus affirmations, streaks, home and lock screen widgets and your own voice recordings.
apps.answer: SayBright is an iPhone and iPad affirmations app with 340 plus affirmations in ten categories such as confidence, gratitude and self love, a daily reminder, streak milestones, home and lock screen widgets, and the option to record affirmations in your own voice, which stay on the phone.
apps.pricing: Free to start. Premium is $0.99 a month or $9.99 a year with a free week, and unlocks every category, widgets and custom affirmations.
bestFor: building a daily affirmation habit
positive affirmations on the lock screen
morning routines and gratitude practice
people who want a low cost affirmation app
features: 340 plus affirmations in ten categories
Daily reminder at a time you pick
Streak milestones from 7 to 365 days
Home and lock screen widgets
Record affirmations in your own voice, stored on device
Share cards for Stories and iMessage
faq: Is SayBright free?
Yes, you can start free. Premium is $0.99 a month or $9.99 a year, with a free week first, and unlocks every category, widgets and custom affirmations.
Can I put affirmations on my lock screen?
Yes. SayBright has home screen and lock screen widgets that refresh through the day.
Can I write my own affirmations?
Yes, with Premium. You can also record affirmations in your own voice, and recordings never leave your phone.
How do streaks work?
Open your daily affirmation each day to build a streak, with celebrations at 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180 and 365 days.

apps.name: BlitzTap
apps.title: BlitzTap: Reaction Time and Reflex Game for iPhone
apps.description: BlitzTap is a free reaction time game for iPhone: tap the matching shape before the clock runs out, with four tiers and streak multipliers.
apps.answer: BlitzTap is a free iPhone and iPad reflex game: a target shape appears, and you tap its match in a grid before the timer runs out. Four tiers shrink the timer to about a second, streaks multiply your score, and there are no energy systems or pay to win. One purchase removes ads.
apps.pricing: Free with ads. A one time purchase removes ads. No subscription.
bestFor: testing and training reaction time
quick games to play in a minute or two
a free game with no energy timers or pay to win
focus and visual search practice
features: Four difficulty tiers
Streak multipliers up to 5x
Haptics and sound on every hit
Personal bests tracked
Reduce Motion and silent switch support
No energy systems, no wait timers
faq: Is BlitzTap free?
Yes. It is free with ads, and a single one time purchase removes them. There is no subscription and nothing pay to win.
Does BlitzTap improve reaction time?
It trains quick visual matching under time pressure and tracks your best scores, so you can see yourself get faster. It is a game, not a medical or cognitive test.

apps.name: TubTender
apps.title: TubTender: Hot Tub Water Test and Chemical Calculator
apps.description: TubTender reads your hot tub test strip and tells you exactly how much of the chemicals you own to add, in what order, and when it is safe to soak.
apps.answer: TubTender is an iPhone app for hot tub water care: tap the colors on your test strip, scan the labels of the chemicals you own, and it gives exact amounts for your tub size in the right order (alkalinity, pH, calcium, then sanitizer) with a countdown until the water is safe. It supports bromine and chlorine and needs no account.
apps.pricing: Free core test and dose plan. Premium monthly or yearly adds trends, full history and fix it guides, with a free week to try it.
bestFor: new hot tub owners who do not know how much chemical to add
bromine or chlorine hot tubs
fixing cloudy, foamy or smelly hot tub water
keeping a test schedule
features: Tap the strip colors instead of typing numbers
Scan chemical bottle labels to get their strength
Exact amounts for your tub size and products
Steps in the right order with wait times
Safe to soak verdict and countdown
No account, data stays on the iPhone
